claims.claim: Estate-planning attorneys generally bill $250 to $500 per hour, and in cities can charge more than $500 per hour, broadly matching the three-to-six-hundred-dollar range.
claims.episode_span: the hours spent by a licensed attorney whose time is valued at three to six hundred dollars per hour
claims.source_title: How Much Will a Lawyer Charge to Write Your Will? - Nolo
claims.supporting_quote: Hourly rates generally run between $250 and $500 per hour. As with flat fees, the hourly rate will depend primarily on the lawyer's experience and training, and where you live. In a small town, you might find someone who bills at $150/hour, but in a city, you might pay more than $500/hour

claims.claim: Fixed-fee online services publish will prices in the low hundreds of dollars (basic last-will packages start at $99 for one person and $199 for two).
claims.episode_span: Fixed-fee services that already publish prices in the low hundreds of dollars demonstrate that movement is possible
claims.source_title: How Much Does a Will Cost? - LegalZoom
claims.supporting_quote: basic last will packages start at $99 for one person and $199 for two people, but you can also research other online services to compare prices

claims.claim: Unauthorized-practice-of-law rules restrict legal work to licensed lawyers, and whether out-of-court document drafting and advice count as practicing law is itself contested.
claims.episode_span: State bar rules that define the practice of law limit who may perform those steps
claims.supporting_quote: What is more controversial is out-of-court activities, particularly drafting of documents and giving advice, and whether that is considered to be unauthorized practice of law
